errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to view this page.

landing.heroTitle: Your whole school in one place
landing.heroText: Grades, attendance, timetables, and direct communication between administration, teachers, students, and parents.
landing.rolesTitle: A platform for everyone at school

roles.admin: Manage the school and organize every detail.
roles.teacher: Take attendance, follow students, and record grades.
roles.student: Timetable, grades, and homework made easy.
roles.parent: Follow your children and stay in touch with the school.

actions.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this?
actions.error: Something went wrong, please try again.

central.heroTitle: Run your school from one place
central.heroText: Register your school now, or sign in to your school with its code.
central.findText: Enter your school code and we will take you to its sign-in page.
central.invalidCode: Use 3-30 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
central.genericError: Something went wrong, please try again.
central.schoolNotFound: School not found. Check the school code.
central.schoolCodeHint: You will type this code when you sign in

people.accountHint: The account gets the default password and must change it at the first sign-in.

actions.resetConfirm: Reset this password to the default one? The user will have to choose a new password at the next sign-in.
actions.resetDone: The password was reset to the default one.

people.nameEnHint: Used to build the student email.

accountCreated.title: Student account created
accountCreated.text: The student signs in with these details and must change the password. Save them now: the password is shown only once.

guardianPicker.label: Find an existing parent
guardianPicker.none: No parent found. Type the email below to create a new one.

staff.title: Staff
staff.scopeHint: Leave the grades empty for a teacher who teaches every grade, and the students empty for boys and girls.

sections.title: Sections the teacher teaches
sections.hint: Leave empty for any section that fits their grades and students. When you choose sections, the teacher teaches only those (e.g. a head of department with one or two sections).

home.title: My children
home.emailHint: Your child signs in with this email
home.empty: No children are linked to your account yet.

attendance.reportHint: Days absent and late for each student.
attendance.saved: Saved. The parents of absent students are being notified.
attendance.alreadyRecorded: This day was already recorded. Saving will correct it.
attendance.noClassrooms: You are not the homeroom teacher of any classroom.
attendance.noAbsences: No student was absent or late in this period.

department.title: Department: {{subject}}
department.cardHint: The teachers of your subject and their classrooms.
department.empty: No teachers in your department yet.

grading.title: Grades
grading.hint: Create quizzes and exams and enter the scores.
grading.weightHint: Share of this assessment in the term grade of the subject.
grading.noAssignments: No subject is assigned to you yet. Ask the administration to assign your classrooms.
grading.scoreTooHigh: A score cannot be higher than {{max}}.
grading.subject: Subject

studentGrades.noRecord: No student record is linked to your account.
studentGrades.empty: No grades have been published for this term yet.

result.makeup: Waiting for the makeup exam (you were absent)

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.empty: No buildings yet. Add the first building of the school.
buildings.levelHint: 0 is the ground floor, 1 the first floor...

generate.title: Generate classrooms
generate.help: For every grade, type how many sections it has. Mixed, boys and girls sections are placed in free classrooms of the floors that serve the grade. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
generate.willCreate: {{created}} sections will be created, {{placed}} of them placed in a room.
generate.unplaced: No room for: {{names}}. You can place them later from the classrooms page.
generate.nothingNew: Nothing new to create: these grades already have the sections you asked for.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.help: The subjects of every grade and their periods per week. An empty box means the grade does not have the subject.
curriculum.subject: Subject
curriculum.confirmPlan: Apply the standard plan to grades 1 to 10? It adds the standard subjects and replaces the subjects and periods of these grades.
curriculum.planApplied: The standard plan was applied to {{applied}} grades and {{created}} subjects were added.
curriculum.planMissing: These grades do not exist yet: {{grades}}. Add them, then apply the plan again.
curriculum.copied: The curriculum was copied to {{count}} grades.
curriculum.copyWarning: The subjects of the grades you tick are replaced.

autoAssign.title: Distribute the teachers
autoAssign.help: Every subject of the curriculum gets a teacher in every classroom that has none yet. A teacher stays in one building and takes as many sections as fit in their weekly load. Existing assignments are kept.
autoAssign.maxLoad: Maximum periods per teacher per week
autoAssign.willAssign: {{count}} assignments will be made with {{teachers}} teachers.
autoAssign.unassigned: {{count}} subjects of classrooms still have no teacher.
autoAssign.subject: Subject
autoAssign.invalid: {{count}} existing assignments are outside the teacher's grades or students. They will be replaced when you apply.

schoolDay.title: School day
schoolDay.help: The school days, the periods of a day and their times. Every section uses the same bells.
schoolDay.longBreakHint: Optional: a longer break after one period (e.g. the 3rd). Leave empty for none.
schoolDay.gradesTitle: Periods a day for each grade
schoolDay.gradesHelp: Leave a grade empty to give it the whole school day ({{count}} periods). Lower grades and the kindergarten usually have fewer (e.g. 6).
schoolDay.saveGrades: Save the periods of the grades
schoolDay.gradesSaved: The periods of the grades were saved.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.noPeriods: Set up the school day first, then generate the timetable.
timetable.generateHelp: Builds the week of every section from the teacher assignments: no teacher in two places, no change of building between two periods, every subject spread over the days. Locked lessons stay. Preview first, nothing is saved until you apply.
timetable.unplaced: These lessons could not be placed:
timetable.withoutTeacher: These subjects have no teacher yet (distribute the teachers first):
timetable.myHint: Your week: which section you teach in every period.
timetable.notReady: The timetable has not been prepared yet.
timetable.incomplete: These sections have empty periods (their curriculum is shorter than their week):
timetable.outOfScope: These assignments are outside the teacher's grades or students, so they were left out (use Distribute automatically to replace them):
timetable.editHelp: A lesson placed by hand is locked, so generating the timetable again keeps it. The teacher must be free and available.

availability.title: Teacher availability
availability.help: Click the periods a teacher cannot teach in (e.g. a part-time teacher). The timetable keeps away from them.
availability.clashes: Saved. These lessons are already in periods the teacher cannot teach in (change them in the timetable):

homework.title: Homework
homework.noneSent: You have not sent any homework yet.
homework.imageHint: Optional: a photo of the page or the task (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB).
homework.hasImage: This homework has a picture. Choose another to replace it.

behavior.title: Behaviour
behavior.criteriaHelp: What students are evaluated on. Add your own, hide a criterion you do not use, or remove it (one already used is only hidden so old results stay).
behavior.noClassrooms: You have no sections to evaluate.
behavior.quickHelp: For a single event today (e.g. helped a friend, or hit a classmate). It is saved with the date above.

builtFrom.weeks: Each week is the mean of the teachers' evaluations of that week.
builtFrom.months: Each month is the mean of its weekly evaluations.
builtFrom.terms: Each term is the mean of its months.
